test_dataset.selection_rule: first N official s0 test recordings per chosen subject, fixed from metadata before opening labels; no replacement

protocol.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of complete recordings with replacement; every selected recording contributes its paired error-difference sum and count, pooled before division; percentile 2.5/97.5.
protocol.checkpoint_policy: Named checkpoint inputs are evaluated as supplied. No test score is used to select, replace, or rank a checkpoint.
protocol.finger_pairing: Requires all15 finger rotations in both branches for same-group paired comparison.

geometry_metrics.mpjpe21_mm: Mean Euclidean predicted MANO/Dex21 joint distance to source joint_3d, unaligned, millimetres.
geometry_metrics.mpvpe778_mm: Mean corresponding MANO778 vertex distance to source-state/source-beta fitted reference mesh, unaligned.
geometry_metrics.wrist_aligned_mpjpe21_mm: Subtract each hand own J0 translation before joint distance; no rotation/scale/PA alignment.
geometry_metrics.wrist_aligned_mpvpe778_mm: Subtract each hand own anatomical wrist translation before vertex distance; no rotation/scale/PA alignment.

protocol.join: (recording, clip_index, reference_index), exact input frame coverage and masks
protocol.limitations: Single-run bounded fixed-camera/GT-crop fitted-MANO evaluation; reference mesh is fitted, not an independent scan. Bootstrap reflects recording resampling only, with limited precision for few recordings; it does not establish causality, seed robustness, detector/SLAM performance or population-wide significance.
protocol.paired_improvement: Matched eligible states; baseline mean minus final mean. Percentage divides by matched baseline mean; >1mm degradation is final-baseline >1.
protocol.state_metrics: Anatomical wrist L2 mm; global root and 15 local finger SO(3) geodesic degrees; finger rotations pooled by actual count.

notes: Primary checkpoint is best300 selected by original fixed8 validation geometry before accessing new test labels. last1000 is a separately named endpoint comparison; no test-based checkpoint replacement.

Source test recordings do not overlap any prepared DexYCB train/val recording. Visual finetune used subject01/02; motion pretraining has other train recordings from test subjects, so not entirely unseen motion subjects.
Test is a metadata-fixed bounded subset of official s0: first2 test recordings per subject03-10, raw frame-id prefix<128. It is not all160 test recordings or all8 cameras.
Baseline is released official HaWoR frontend with PAM, same GT crops/fixed camera and original16-frame context. No detector, SLAM or infiller benchmark.
Candidate already includes first TWM refinement and prior-frame final history; candidate-to-final compares last refinement only.
Prediction FK always uses own predicted beta and official HaWoR left shapedirs flip. GT mesh uses source beta with no-left-fix codec; no GT beta supplied to any model.
All figures and numerical analysis ran remotely. Raw RGB, reference arrays, prediction tensors, per-frame CSV, licensed assets and model weights remain remote.
